lede: Class labels hold on Fashion-MNIST, but PatchGAN on digits repeats one glyph.
points: Conditional GAN, PatchGAN, and feature matching
title: Conditional GAN and two other variants
question: Does a class label, a PatchGAN discriminator, or feature matching change quality and diversity?
process: The conditional generator concatenates the noise with an embedding of the class label. The matching discriminator concatenates that same embedding with the image. The PatchGAN discriminator concatenates a one-hot map onto the image and scores patches instead of the whole picture. Both losses stay the binary cross-entropy from the vanilla GAN, now conditioned on the label.
Feature matching adds one extra term to the generator. It is an L1 distance between the mean discriminator features of the fake batch and the mean features of the real batch, with weight 10:

Digits and Fashion-MNIST share the training loop. Only the variant and the dataset change. Across the six runs, each on 250 images per class, the spread ratios sit between 0.88 and 1.12. PatchGAN on digits still repeats one glyph.

opening.summary: The bar is sample standard deviation divided by the standard deviation of real images. The vanilla runs sit near 0.04 and 0.08. The six conditional runs sit between 0.88 and 1.12. The class grid shows what that ratio hides.
opening.hover: Each bar opens the class grid for that run.

charts.title: Sample spread relative to real images

marks.label: Vanilla digits
marks.answers: What didn't turn out as expected?
marks.summary: Vanilla digits, from the earlier run: sample standard deviation 0.0134 divided by 0.378 on real images is 0.035. The collapse flag is set. The grid is one repeated stroke. The class-conditional runs below use the same training procedure with a label added.

marks.label: Vanilla Fashion
marks.answers: What didn't turn out as expected?
marks.summary: Vanilla Fashion-MNIST: 0.0413 divided by 0.531 is 0.078. The collapse flag is set. The grid is one shirt.

marks.label: cGAN digits
marks.summary: Conditional GAN on digits: sample standard deviation 0.6362 divided by 0.6074 on real images is 1.05. The collapse flag is not set. Diversity is 0.630 and class separation is 0.636. Each row is a different digit. Sharpness is 0.628 against 0.256 on real ink, so the strokes are speckled. The generator loss equals the binary cross-entropy, at 2.074, so this run has no feature-matching term. The held-out discriminator loss is 0.216.
marks.frameCaption: Conditional GAN on digits. The early rows hold, and the lower rows speckle.

marks.label: cGAN Fashion
marks.summary: Conditional GAN on Fashion-MNIST: 0.6140 divided by 0.6468 is 0.95. The collapse flag is not set. Diversity is 0.560 and class separation is 0.600. The rows separate into shirts, trousers, shoes, and bags, and they are speckled. Sharpness is 0.698 against 0.301 on real images. The held-out discriminator loss is 0.665, and the generator loss is 3.257, equal to the binary cross-entropy.
marks.frameCaption: Conditional GAN on Fashion-MNIST. Shirts and trousers separate. Boots and bags do not.

marks.label: PatchGAN digits
marks.answers: What didn't turn out as expected?
marks.summary: PatchGAN on digits: 0.5365 divided by 0.6074 is 0.88, so the collapse flag is not set and the ratio looks healthy. The class grid is still one binary glyph on every row. The pixel standard deviation stays high because that glyph is high-contrast and jitters. The label did not change the picture. Diversity is 0.537, class separation is 0.537, and sharpness is 0.393 against 0.256 on real images. The held-out discriminator loss is 0.611, and the generator loss is 2.814, equal to the binary cross-entropy.
marks.hover: Ratio 0.88, and every class row is the same glyph.
marks.frameCaption: PatchGAN on digits. One glyph in every row.

marks.label: PatchGAN Fashion
marks.summary: PatchGAN on Fashion-MNIST: 0.7122 divided by 0.6468 is 1.10. The collapse flag is not set. The class grid does change with the label. Shirts, trousers, coats, sandals, bags, and shoes are different rows, and they read as garments more clearly than the speckled conditional GAN. Diversity is 0.675, class separation is 0.637, and sharpness is 0.427 against 0.301 on real images. The held-out discriminator loss is 1.075, and the generator loss is 1.030.
marks.hover: Ratio 1.10. The class rows are different garments.
marks.frameCaption: PatchGAN on Fashion-MNIST. Each row is a different garment.

marks.label: FM loss, digits
marks.summary: Feature matching on digits: 0.5624 divided by 0.6074 is 0.93. The collapse flag is not set. The class rows are different digits, and they are still speckled. Diversity is 0.554, class separation is 0.561, and sharpness is 0.471 against 0.256 on real images, closer to real ink than the conditional GAN’s 0.628. The generator loss is 6.539 and the binary cross-entropy is 2.976, so the feature-matching term is in the objective. The held-out discriminator loss is 0.449.
marks.frameCaption: Feature matching on digits. 0, 1, and 3 hold.

marks.label: FM loss, Fashion
marks.answers: Why do you think the results might not be great?
marks.summary: Feature matching on Fashion-MNIST: 0.7266 divided by 0.6468 is 1.12. The collapse flag is not set, and diversity is 0.656, the high end of this table. The class grid is less readable than PatchGAN on Fashion-MNIST: several rows are speckled blobs, and a few still suggest a shirt, a sandal, or a bag. Sharpness is 0.672 against 0.301 on real images. The generator loss is 7.411 against a binary cross-entropy of 2.706. The extra term is active, and it did not produce a cleaner garment.
marks.frameCaption: Feature matching on Fashion-MNIST. Speckled columns.

reflection.worked: Digits and Fashion-MNIST share the training loop. Only the data load and the variant change. Class labels stop the vanilla collapse. On Fashion-MNIST, PatchGAN rows are different clothes. Feature matching on digits moves sharpness from the conditional GAN’s 0.628 toward real ink, to 0.471.
reflection.unexpected: PatchGAN on digits has a spread ratio of 0.88 and the collapse flag is not set, yet every class row is the same glyph. Feature matching on Fashion-MNIST has high diversity and speckled rows. The saved hyperparameters record only the conditional GAN.
reflection.why: The collapse flag fires only when the ratio is under 0.2. A reasonable reading is that a PatchGAN on a thin stroke collapses to one glyph that is still high-contrast, while the same discriminator keeps a wide garment silhouette.
reflection.improve: Read the class grid next to the ratio. On digits, keep the conditional GAN or feature matching. On Fashion-MNIST, train the PatchGAN longer. Compare the generator’s binary cross-entropy across variants, and keep the feature-matching term on its own axis.
